description: See how much of a long diff you've read, with a viewed count beside bb's own Viewed checkboxes and the same marks on GitHub. The changes panel toolbar counts the files you have checked, such as 3/6 viewed, across every file in the range. On a thread with an open pull request, checking a file in bb marks it viewed on GitHub, and a file marked viewed on GitHub is checked in bb. A file with edits you have not pushed shows a Local icon until a push makes its diff match the pull request's. Requires bb 0.47 or later, and GitHub sync needs the gh CLI signed in.
